title: Seek
gkm: To seek, to search for, to look for; to strive after and investigate with care.
hbm: To seek early, to seek diligently, as at the break of day.
refs: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness
And ye shall seek me, and find me
Those that seek me early shall find me
Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find
